metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T08 (TRL 5) have reasonable 2-year development windows, but T03 (TRL 7→completion) is scheduled as a zero-duration project (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is unrealistic for even a mature technology requiring integration and validation.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio leans toward mid-to-high TRL technologies (5-7) with relatively short timelines, which is more consistent with market-profit strategies; a true 기술선도 portfolio would include lower-TRL exploratory technologies and a longer R&D horizon extending well beyond 2030.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The roadmap shows no explicit competitive differentiation rationale or evidence of competitor positioning analysis; technology selections appear driven by dependency chains rather than strategic competitive gap exploitation in the autonomous driving landscape.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도 strategy, technologies should complete 1-2 years before market boom windows, but all three technologies complete after their boom windows (T01: 0.75yr late, T08: 2.25yr late, T03: 2.0yr late), meaning the portfolio consistently misses even the market-profit timing window, let alone the preemption window.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (sensor fusion, 3D pose estimation, steer-by-wire) are active patent areas with real market growth, suggesting some convergence awareness, but the narrow 3-technology portfolio and absence of emerging convergence areas like LiDAR-AI fusion or edge computing limits this assessment to coincidental rather than deliberate targeting.

strengths: Zero dependency violations — the sequential T01→T08→T03 chain is logically sound and properly respected in scheduling
Budget utilization is exactly at capacity with no overrun, indicating disciplined financial planning
weaknesses: All three technologies complete after their respective market boom windows, with a mean timing error of 1.67 years — this is a fundamental strategic failure for both 기술선도 and 시장이익최대 strategies

The portfolio is extremely narrow (only 3 technologies) and skewed toward higher TRL levels, which contradicts the 기술선도 mandate that requires exploratory, lower-TRL investments to establish technology leadership
missing_technologies: LiDAR-based perception systems (lower TRL, high patent activity, foundational for 기술선도)
Edge AI inference accelerators for ADAS (emerging convergence zone)
V2X communication modules (critical ecosystem technology for autonomous driving leadership)
High-definition map generation and localization (key differentiator in autonomous driving platform)
investment_issues: All three technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier despite the portfolio lacking true exploratory/frontier investments expected in a 기술선도 strategy
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 (TRL 7, lowest uncertainty score of 2.0) receiving High-tier investment suggests over-investment in a near-mature technology relative to the strategic direction
timing_issues: 3D 포즈 추정 시스템 completes 2.25 years after its 2027-Q4 boom — entirely misses the market window and provides no preemption advantage
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 has a zero-duration development phase (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is not credible for system integration and validation
다중 센서 퓨전 카메라 completes 0.75 years after its boom; even with 기술선도 strategy requiring early completion, this is late rather than preemptive
